summary: Configured node1 as the source of truth for `/etc/inventory/app.conf`. Changes are pushed atomically to node2 through an immediate systemd path watcher with a persistent five-minute timer fallback. Both sequential node restarts passed persistence and recovery checks. RHEL 9.8 and kernel 5.14.0-687.20.1.el9_8 were retained.
actions_performed: Initialized the previously missing source file on node1 with harmless configuration comments.
Generated a dedicated ED25519 credential on node1 and restricted its authorization on node2 to node1's cluster IP.
Installed and enabled the synchronization service, path watcher, and five-minute persistent timer on node1.
Verified live changes synchronized in three seconds before restarts and four seconds after both restarts.
Restarted node1 and node2 sequentially, verifying changed boot identities and full recovery after each.

evidence.requirement: Synchronize node2 from node1 within 15 minutes
evidence.summary: Watcher and timer were enabled; a timestamped source change reached node2 in three seconds with matching SHA-256, ownership, and mode.
A post-restart change reached node2 in four seconds with identical SHA-256 and metadata.
Node-generated credential, source-IP-restricted authorization, pinned host key, and noninteractive connectivity were verified.

Healthy baseline and restart acknowledgement were captured. Boot ID changed from 437b338f-0902-4c11-86df-0a6ea6308b8e to 2a898709-1539-471f-bf51-4ce2a8621f7d; services, source data, and live synchronization recovered.
Healthy baseline and restart acknowledgement were captured. Boot ID changed from 6bb7e004-1e2e-46ac-bfd7-fafa248a4e76 to 424e54f2-8a87-43fa-9f24-43d45593156e; SSH and synchronized data recovered.

evidence.requirement: Retain installed operating-system release and kernel
evidence.summary: Both nodes remained on RHEL 9.8 with kernel 5.14.0-687.20.1.el9_8; no package installation or OS/kernel update was performed.
